description: Original synthetic arcade-announcer dialogue. Not a recording, imitation, or clone of a named performer or game announcer.

generation.engine: Piper TTS (offline generation only; engine and model are not shipped with the game)
generation.dataset: LJ Speech, public-domain recordings and transcripts
generation.training: The model card states this voice was trained from scratch on LJ Speech, not fine-tuned from a Lessac voice.
generation.processing: Original short phrases, moderate pitch lowering with formants preserved, high/low-pass filtering, compression, short 55ms slap echo, limited output level. No third-party recording embedded.
